title: Towards a Data-Centric Understanding of Spatial Reasoning in Multimodal Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.19108v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have been widely applied in embodied agents and robotics for vision tasks. However, MLLMs suffer from limitations in spatial reasoning and perception. Post-training techniques have shown promise for improving these capabilities; yet, there are limited data-driven surveys of such approaches. In this survey, we consider approaches to fine-tuning pretrained MLLMs for spatial reasoning tasks, ranging from supervised to reinforcement learning, with an emphasis on the datasets used. We investigate themes of dataset construction, data modality and annotation, and evaluation of the resulting models. Based on these themes, we categorize research into three groups: dataset design, dataset construction and evaluation. translated_title: 迈向对多模态大语言模型空间推理的以数据为中心的理解
translated_abstract: 多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）已被广泛应用于具身智能体和机器人领域的视觉任务中。然而，MLLMs 在空间推理和感知方面存在局限性。后训练技术已展现出提升这些能力的潜力；然而，针对此类方法的以数据为中心的调研仍然有限。在本综述中，我们考察了为空间推理任务对预训练 MLLMs 进行微调的各种方法，涵盖从监督学习到强化学习，并重点关注所使用的数据集。我们研究了数据集构建、数据模态与标注以及所得到模型的评估等主题。基于这些主题，我们将相关研究分为三类：数据集设计、数据集构建与评估。我们发现了构建固定空间标注的四种主要方法：规则与模板、LLM 提示、程序化生成以及人在回路。我们还观察到了相当大的差异……
tldr: 本综述以数据为中心系统梳理了用于多模态大语言模型空间推理的微调方法，将研究归纳为数据集设计、数据集构建与评估三大类，并总结出规则与模板、LLM 提示、程序化生成和人在回路四种主要的空间标注构建方法。
en_tdlr: This survey provides a data-centric understanding of fine-tuning MLLMs for spatial reasoning, categorizing research into dataset design, dataset construction, and evaluation, and identifying four main methods for constructing spatial annotations: rules and templates, LLM prompting, procedural generation, and human-in-the-loop.
